name: Computational Intelligence Laboratory
vision: We develop physical AI that can perceive, reason about, and act in the real world. Our research connects multimodal perception, spatial intelligence, and embodied learning to turn observations into meaningful action.
visionGoal: By learning from visual experience, simulation, and real-world interaction, we aim to build intelligent systems that adapt to unfamiliar environments and work alongside people.

homePhotos.alt: First Meeting of KMU CILAB, June 2025

research.title: Perceive the World
research.summary: Connect visual and multimodal observations to concepts that generalize across the open world.
research.description: Physical intelligence begins with sensing. We study how machines can learn meaningful representations from visual and multimodal experience, recognize what matters, and connect observations to language. Our goal is perception that remains useful across changing viewpoints, environments, and tasks.
research.imageAlt: Concept illustration of visual observations and multimodal perception

research.title: Understand the Scene
research.summary: Build structured, persistent understanding of space, objects, and how the world changes.
research.description: Useful perception must become an understanding of the surrounding world. We investigate representations that connect geometry, semantics, and dynamics, allowing an agent to locate itself, remember its surroundings, and reason about possible changes. This direction connects 3D scene learning with spatial memory and predictive world models.
research.imageAlt: Concept illustration of 3D scene reconstruction and spatial understanding

research.title: Move into Reality
research.summary: Turn perception and understanding into adaptive action through interaction with the physical world.
research.description: We aim to close the loop between seeing, understanding, and doing. Our research explores agents that connect human intent to action and learn from videos, simulation, and physical interaction. We work toward adaptable robot intelligence that can navigate, interact, and improve through experience in real environments.
topics: Learning across video, simulation, and reality
research.imageAlt: Concept illustration of a mobile manipulator navigating and interacting with objects
